item.title: Duolingo Shares Fall On Tepid Sales Outlook
item.description: Duolingo Inc. shares fell as much as 12% on Wednesday after the company’s conservative revenue outlook for the current quarter overshadowed user growth.

item.title: Celestica Joins Data Center Funding Rush With $3 Billion Deal
item.description: Celestica Inc. is looking to raise $3 billion from selling new shares, joining a flurry of companies raising funds for data centers to power the artificial intelligence buildout.

item.title: Yen Seen Gaining 6% Against Dollar by End of 2026, Bank of America Says
item.description: The Japanese yen will strengthen about 6% against the dollar by year-end following coordinated currency intervention, according to revised expectations from Bank of America Corp.

item.title: Avocado Imports at Risk as US Halts Government Work in Michoacán
item.description: The US suspended government activities in the Mexican state of Michoacán, affecting imports of avocados from the largest producing region in the country to the US.

item.title: CME, FanDuel Venture Falters as Prediction Startups Race Ahead
item.description: CME Group Inc. and FanDuel are scaling back a joint effort to take on prediction market startups after failing to gain traction in a booming industry that has quickly come to represent a threat to both Wall Street exchanges and traditional sportsbooks.

item.title: Zillow’s Revenue Jumps as Rentals Offer ‘Bright Spot’
item.description: Zillow Group Inc. said Wednesday that second-quarter revenue jumped 18% from a year earlier to $772 million, as the online real estate company sees rental agreements growing more quickly than home purchases on its website and app.

item.title: Blue Owl BDCs Buy Back $90 Million of Shares to Support Value
item.description: Two private credit funds managed by Blue Owl Capital Inc. bought back a combined $90 million of shares, marking a consecutive quarter of repurchases as the asset manager sought to steady the vehicles’ value amid turbulence in the sector.

item.title: Meta Debuts AI Coding Agent in Race With OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. Chief Executive Officer Mark Zuckerberg announced the release of the company’s first AI coding agent, known as Muse Code, stepping up competition with OpenAI and Anthropic PBC.

item.title: Japanese Yen Intervention: Why Bessent Wants Fed to Expand FIMA Backstop
item.description: On the heels of one of the most dramatic currency‑market interventions in decades — a joint Japanese‑US effort beginning in late July to bolster the weakening yen — US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent surprised financial markets by urging the Federal Reserve to expand an obscure lending program to aid Tokyo’s efforts to defend its currency.

item.title: Phillips 66 Expects Soaring Fuel Margins to Last Into 2027
item.description: Fuel-makers enjoying skyrocketing profits will likely keep reaping standout margins through the next quarter and beyond, according to an executive from a top US refiner.

item.title: EBay Reports Strong Results, Says It Paid More to Acquire Depop
item.description: EBay Inc. reported a solid second quarter but said its purchase price for second-hand clothing marketplace Depop was $200 million more than initially announced, which could weigh on earnings in the current period.

item.title: DoorDash Issues Strong Outlook But Warns of Heightened Spending
item.description: DoorDash Inc. issued a profit forecast that surpassed analysts’ expectations, citing a boom in paid subscribers who are ordering takeout and grocery more frequently.

item.title: Dorsey’s Block Boosts Profit Outlook as Revamp Takes Shape
item.description: Block Inc. lifted its annual profit guidance on Wednesday after delivering quarterly results that topped expectations due to growth in both its Square and Cash App businesses.

item.title: MercadoLibre Tumbles as E-Commerce Giant Hints at More Spending
item.description: MercadoLibre Inc. shares plummeted in late trading as analysts worried about the e-commerce giant’s spending plans despite it reporting sales and profits that beat consensus estimates in the second quarter.

item.title: Fed’s Cook Says Ready to Raise Rates If Inflation Doesn’t Cool
item.description: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook repeated a message that she is ready to raise interest rates if inflation doesn’t slow, warning that policymakers may not have the luxury of waiting before inflation returns to their 2% target.

item.title: Expedia Boosts Its Full-Year Sales Outlook on Strong Bookings
item.description: Expedia Group Inc. raised its annual sales forecast, signaling that consumers aren’t being deterred by higher hotel prices and airfare.

item.title: Fitch Adds to Hundreds of CLOs Slated for Rating Upgrades
item.description: Fitch Ratings said it’s upgrading 30 portions of collateralized loan obligations, in addition to the hundreds of tranches it had said previously it was considering for upgrades under a new methodology.

item.title: AI Risks Require Tougher Cyber Defenses, Top US Officials Warn
item.description: The US government’s top information security official warned that computer systems nationwide need to bolster their defenses to meet the growing threat of cyberattacks powered by artificial intelligence.

item.title: SolarEdge Says US Home Solar Market Weak Due to Financing Issues
item.description: SolarEdge Technologies CEO Shuki Nir says uncertainty over new tax credit rules for home solar equipment has made it more challenging for providers to raise financing for the systems and has led to softer customer demand for panels.

item.title: Ghana Made $1.9 Billion Loss on Gold Purchases in 2025, IMF Says
item.description: Ghana’s central bank incurred losses of 22 billion cedis ($1.9 billion) in 2025 under a domestic gold purchase program aimed at boosting the country’s foreign-exchange reserves.

item.title: Iran-Linked Cyberattacks on US Water Utilities Continue
item.description: The incidents are expanding and ongoing, according to an information-sharing center.

item.title: Microsoft’s AI Sales Mostly Come From OpenAI, Disclosures Show
item.description: Microsoft Corp. generates most of its artificial intelligence revenue from OpenAI, according to new disclosures from the company.

item.title: Mosaic Phosphate Pains Highlight Hormuz Fertilizer Disruption
item.description: Mosaic Co.’s pullbacks in fertilizer production haven’t been enough to alleviate the impact of surging input costs from the war in Iran.

item.title: Arini, Silver Point Among Lenders Set to Take Over Pfleiderer
item.description: A bondholder group is set to take over Pfleiderer, the struggling wood-paneling company backed by Strategic Value Partners, despite the firm raising fresh debt just eight months ago.

item.title: Ares Eyes $2 Billion Loan Deal in Private Credit’s Slow Year
item.description: Ares Management Corp. is leading a $2.2 billion direct loan to help finance a healthcare services acquisition, in one of the biggest deals since the private credit market was roiled by record redemptions this year.

item.title: BC Partners’ Credit Arm Explores Extending Lifeline to LIV Golf
item.description: BC Partners’ credit arm is leading a group of investors looking at lending money to LIV Golf, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Boeing-Lockheed Rocket Joint Venture Taps Private Bond Market
item.description: Boeing Co. and Lockheed Martin Corp.’s rocket joint venture plans to sell bonds in the private market to refinance debt.

item.title: Canada Billionaire Buys Half of Tech Fund, Commits $125 Million
item.description: A Canadian real estate billionaire acquired half of tech investment firm Vistara Growth, committing as much as $125 million to a new fund in a deal with roots in a business school friendship formed three decades ago.

item.title: Colombia Seizes Explosives Ahead of De la Espriella Inauguration
item.description: Colombian authorities intercepted a bus rigged with explosives in the country’s southwest on Wednesday, underscoring security concerns ahead of President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella’s inauguration.

item.title: Victor Niederhoffer Will Be Missed
item.description: By many friends and speculators.
